posts.title: Why Dealing With Sadness as a Man Is So Hard
posts.description: Anger is the one feeling men are allowed to show, so sadness often comes out as anger. Why that happens, the risk of lashing out and what helps.

posts.title: What I Learned Dating an Avoidant Woman
posts.description: When I asked to get closer, she often got angry and shut down. What research says about avoidant people, why asking backfires and what helps.

posts.title: How to Live in Clown World Without Becoming a Clown
posts.description: Clown world names a real feeling. What research says about why the world seems absurd, what Terence McKenna predicted, and how to keep your judgment.
